_meta.voice: Calm, direct, HR-operator facing. No hype, no apologies, no AI-marketing language. Two sentences max where possible. Concrete, not abstract.
_meta._notes: FR / NO localization deferred to Cohort 4. All strings pass relopass-brand-audit conventions (no 'powerful', 'seamless', 'journey', 'all-in-one').

welcome.first_time: Hi {first_name}. I'll help you get the documents your HR team needs.
welcome.returning: Welcome back, {first_name}. Picking up where you left off.
welcome.resumed_session: You have {pending_count} items pending. Let's keep going.
welcome.completed_all: All documents in. Your case is with HR.

intake.ask_purpose: Quick question first — what's the purpose of your move?
intake.ask_corridor: Where are you moving from and to?
intake.ready_to_collect: Got it. Here's what HR will need from you.

upload.passport_td3: Upload a clear photo or scan of your passport's photo page.
upload.employment_contract: Upload your signed employment contract — all pages.
upload.eu_residence_permit: Upload your EU residence permit, both sides.
upload.eu_national_id: Upload your national ID card, both sides.
upload.visa_stamp: Upload the page of your passport showing the entry visa.
upload.offer_letter: Upload the offer letter, signed if available.
upload.tax_record: Upload your most recent annual tax document.
upload.police_clearance: Upload your police clearance (issued within the last 6 months).
upload.proof_of_address: Upload a utility bill or bank letter from the last 3 months.
upload.health_insurance_proof: Upload proof of health insurance coverage for your destination country.
upload.bank_statement: Upload your most recent bank statement.
upload.drag_or_click: Drag a file here, or tap to choose one.
upload.tip_quality: Tip: good lighting, all corners visible, no glare.

low_confidence.ambiguous: I'm not certain I read this correctly. Can you confirm: {extracted_value}?
low_confidence.field_missing: I couldn't find this field. Can you type it in?
low_confidence.field_partial: I got part of it: {partial_value}. Can you complete it?

escalate.ask_send_to_hr: Send this to HR for review?
escalate.ask_send_no: Not yet — let me try again
escalate.sent_confirmation: Sent to HR. You'll get an email when they respond.
escalate.sent_subline: Typical response: within one business day.

we_cannot.contradiction_two_docs: Two documents disagree about your {field_label}. HR needs to look at this — I've flagged it for them.
we_cannot.missing_required: I need {field_label} to continue, but I can't find it on what you've uploaded. Could you upload a document that shows it, or ask HR?
we_cannot.out_of_scope: This is outside what I can help with. I've flagged it for your HR contact.
we_cannot.policy_question: Policy questions are for HR — I don't make those calls. I've forwarded your question.
we_cannot.legal_question: Legal advice isn't something I can give. Your HR team can route you to the right person.

error.file_too_large: That file is over 20MB. Try compressing or splitting it.
error.file_unsupported: I can read PDFs and most image types. This one isn't supported — can you re-export?
error.file_corrupted: That file didn't open cleanly. Can you re-upload it?
error.ocr_low_quality: The image is too blurry to read. Try a clearer photo or scan.
error.ocr_no_text: I couldn't find readable text on this. Is it the right document?
error.network: Connection dropped. Try again in a moment.
error.session_expired: Your session timed out. Sign in to continue where you left off.
error.rate_limited: Too many uploads at once. Wait 30 seconds and try again.
error.unknown: Something went wrong on my side. HR has been notified.

success.all_complete_pending_hr: Looks good. Your case is now ready for HR review.
success.all_complete_done: Everything's in order. Your case is moving forward.

consent.intro: Before we start, a quick note on data.
consent.purpose: Your documents are used only for your relocation case. HR sees them. We do not sell or share them.
consent.retention: We keep them for the duration of your assignment plus 12 months, then delete.
consent.rights: You can ask to see, correct, or delete your data at any time.
